business_scope.primary_industry_name: Digital Advertising Media Arbitrage and Affiliate Lead Gen

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English common law foundation with French civil law influence; codified statutes and English judicial precedent; final appellate court is the Court of Appeal of Vanuatu.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty (BIT) in force
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) with Australia, in force 2010
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) with New Zealand, in force 2009
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus), trade agreement in force 2020
Participation in the OECD/Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Primary AML/CFT statute: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 12 of 2018, as amended; Beneficial ownership register requirements: Companies Act [Cap. 191], as amended, and International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended; VFIU Regulations and VFSC Guidance Notes; International Companies (Amendment) legislation imposing UBO filing with VFSC through a VFSC-licensed registered agent.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified true copy of passport for each proposed director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or recognized certifying authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization - Vanuatu is not a Hague Apostille Contracting State, so notarization followed by Vanuatu consular legalization is the strict statutory path; apostille may be accepted as supporting evidence only where the origin country is a Hague Contracting Party and the registered agent agrees.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (bank statement or utility bill issued within last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Original issuing financial institution or utility provider; notarization by local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization - Vanuatu is not a Hague Apostille Contracting State, so notarization followed by Vanuatu consular legalization is the strict statutory path; apostille may be accepted as supporting evidence only where the origin country is a Hague Contracting Party and the registered agent agrees.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or professional opinion letter from an account-holding bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or regulated financial institution where the beneficial owner maintains a relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization - if issued by a foreign bank outside Vanuatu, the signature of the bank officer must be notarized and the document legalized through the Vanuatu consular process; where the bank is a Hague-state entity, an apostille may be used with registered-agent acceptance.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: AML/CFT corporate due diligence questionnaire, source of wealth declaration, and source of funds statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Prepared by proposed directors/UBOs and witnessed by the VFSC-licensed registered agent or notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization - witness signatures on the questionnaire must be notarized; if executed outside Vanuatu, the notary's signature must be legalized by consular means or apostilled where accepted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of constitutional/corporate documents for any legal entity shareholder (certificate of incorporation, memorandum, articles, certificate of incumbency)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the shareholder entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization - corporate registry extracts must be certified and then apostilled/legalized; Vanuatu consular legalization is required for entities from non-Hague countries.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed engagement letter and consent to act with the VFSC-licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant company and the licensed registered agent in Vanuatu
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization - signatures of non-resident directors must be notarized and, unless exempted by the agent's internal policy, consular legalized or apostilled.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, UBOs, signatories, and counterparties against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, UK HM Treasury consolidated list, EU consolidated sanctions list, and VFIU/domestic watchlists. PEP determination follows the AMLCFT Act definition of prominent public functions, including family members and close associates; any PEP match requires enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, documented source of wealth and source of funds, and ongoing transaction monitoring. All screening results must be retained by the registered agent in the corporate due diligence file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry - International Companies Name Reservation module accessible through the official VFSC website (vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Roman/Latin script. Bislama, English, and French are acceptable official languages. Non-Roman characters (e.g., Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic) are not permitted in the registered name; any desired non-Latin script name must first be transliterated into Latin-script English or French and filed through the registered agent with a certified transliteration explanation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A registered agent may file an extension application with the VFSC before expiry of the initial 30-day reservation window, paying the applicable VFSC fee. If the proposed name is rejected, the registered agent will receive the Registrar's written grounds of refusal. The applicant may lodge an administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the refusal notice, supported by written submissions and any evidence of third-party consent or distinctiveness. If the administrative appeal is denied, judicial review may be sought by filing an originating application in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 30 days of the denial; however, practical market practice is to select a new name and resubmit because judicial review is exceptional and time-consuming.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for an unlicensed digital media-buying and affiliate lead-generation affiliate: VFSC requires only a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu. The registered office must be a physical street address in Vanuatu (not a PO Box) maintained by a VFSC-licensed agent. The company may conduct all substantive operations overseas through a virtual office/back-office; no local employees, physical premises, or local board meetings are mandatory for an International Company of this type.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 10% in the first two years for a medium-risk enhanced-due-diligence sector. Unannounced physical on-site inspections are discretionary and are not routine for non-licensed administrative International Companies; however, the likelihood materially increases upon a sanctions/PEP hit, unusual transaction volume, unexplained source of wealth, or adverse regulatory intelligence from the VFIU or global financial intelligence exchange.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1995 (Cap 222), ss 7-11 (incorporation procedure, memorandum, certificate of incorporation), s 16 (registered office and agent), s 18 (articles); International Companies (Amendment) Act 2016; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act, Cap 295.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Trusts Registry (International Companies Registry)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution) together with Form IC-01 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; authorized share capital may be set at USD 100 or as stated in the Memorandum. Shares may be issued at par at the discretion of the board. No escrow account or capital deposit is required by the VFSC for international companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the incorporator hereby adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company and confirms that the registered office shall be maintained at Port Vila, Efate, Vanuatu, at the office of the licensed registered agent. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT one ordinary share with a par value of US$1.00 be allotted, issued and fully paid to the founding subscriber. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [Name] be appointed sole Director and [Name] be appointed Company Secretary, each empowered singly to sign banking instructions, execute agreements and oversee statutory filings. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT management is authorised to expend up to US$2,000 to register with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and effect this resolution immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name pre-clearance and registered agent engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company names for approval via the licensed registered agent. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity and must not imply government patronage. Simultaneously execute an engagement letter with a VFSC-licensed management company that will act as registered agent and provide the statutory registered office in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request (Form Name-V)
Engagement letter with licensed registered agent
Corporate KYC pack (passport copies, proof of address, bank reference) for beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, submit alternate names within 3 business days; no fresh fee is charged for a single substitute, and the agent will liaise with the Registry to expedite clearance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of constitutional documents and officer consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent under supervision of VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association conforming to Schedule 2 of the International Companies Act 1995, including authorized share capital, objects clause, and director powers. Obtain signed consents from the initial director, secretary, and shareholder, with passport copies notarized or certified by a commissioner for oaths if individuals are absent from Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as director and secretary
Subscriber signature page with witness attestation
Certified passport copies and proof of residential address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries defective clauses (e.g., objects ultra vires), the registered agent will revise the governing documents and refile within 5 business days; VFSC typically allows informal amendments before payment of any penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory filing of incorporation documents and fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, Form IC-01, and the registered agent’s consent via the VFSC online portal or over the counter at the Registry in Port Vila. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 300 plus the registered agent’s professional fee. The application is effective on the date and time stamped by the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form IC-01 (Application for Incorporation)
Registered agent consent form and registered office confirmation
Declaration of compliance signed by the applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for illegible signatures or missing consents, the registered agent will cure the defect with scanned replacement pages within 7 days. If rejection is maintained, the agent may appeal to the Registrar under section 10 of the Act or withdraw and refile with corrected documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful verification, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number and date of incorporation. The company becomes a separate legal entity with limited liability. The certificate is scanned to the agent; the original may be couriered to the beneficial owner if required. Request a certificate of good standing concurrently for banking purposes.
required_dossiers: None (automatic issuance after step 3)
Optional letter to VFSC requesting Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, return it physically or by email to the Registry with a cover letter requesting re-issuance under the correction procedure; VFSC typically issues a corrected certificate within 2 business days at no cost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate governance formation – first board resolution, share issuance, statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company board of directors acting through the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (or pass a unanimous written resolution) adopting the pro-forma First Board Resolution, allotting the initial shares, appointing directors and company secretary, and approving the corporate seal if any. Open the statutory registers (members, directors, secretary, charges, and options) and minute book, which must be kept at the registered office in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma First Board Resolution (as set out above)
Share certificates issued to the founding subscriber
Register of members, directors, and secretary
Minutes of first board meeting or written resolution with signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If statutory registers are incomplete, the registered agent shall reconstruct the registers and, where applicable, file a late report with VFSC confirming solvency and the absence of adverse third-party claims to avoid examination under the Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Regulatory registrations, AML compliance preparation, and banking onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC AML/CFT supervision unit, Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), and financial institutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete VFSC AML/CFT risk assessment and, if the entity will pool funds for clients, register as a Reporting Entity with the VFSC. Since the business is offshore media arbitrage with no local physical operation, no Vanuatu business licence is required; should an office be leased in Port Vila, apply for a Business Licence through VIPA. Commence bank onboarding with a licensed bank or authorised payment institution providing the required corporate and beneficial ownership documents.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum/Articles
First Board Resolution and register of directors
Beneficial ownership declaration and AML/CFT questionnaire
Business plan and source of funds statement
Passport copies of ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If financial institutions request enhanced due diligence, provide notarized apostilled copies of the constitutional documents and a recent certificate of good standing; if query persists, use a parallel regulated payment provider (EMI) while the primary account is under review.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Commerce and Ni-Vanuatu Business (for local Business Licence issuance if physical premises are established)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence (Business Licence Act, Cap 248) – only required where the International Company maintains a physical office or staff in Vanuatu; pure offshore digital advertising and media buying conducted entirely outside Vanuatu is exempt from local licensing

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Exempt from Full EIA Report. Digital advertising and media arbitrage is not a scheduled undertaking under the EIA Regulations; an EIA Exemption/Registration certificate may be obtained administratively for lender or landlord compliance, but no scoping or full environmental impact assessment is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or combustion emissions from core operations. Office wastewater must connect to municipal sewerage or approved septic systems. E-waste (servers, monitors, batteries) must be collected by a DEPC-registered e-waste recycler and cannot be sent to municipal landfill; general office waste must comply with municipal solid waste collection standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Vanuatu Fire Service and Emergency Services (VFSES) for any leased office, including smoke detection and extinguisher placement; building occupancy approval from the Public Works Department for commercial space; workplace health and safety clearance covering workstation ergonomics, electrical wiring safety, and emergency evacuation plans; cyclone preparedness measures (window protection and emergency supply kit) recommended by the National Disaster Management Office.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs & Inland Revenue Service (VCIRS), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; the statutory authority for value added tax, customs, and excise. Customs export declarations are lodged through the ASYCUDA electronic clearance gateway; company registration and annual licence fees are administered separately by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), www.vfsc.vu. There is no national online VAT e-filing portal; VAT registration and returns are processed on a paper or direct-submission basis at the VCIRS VAT Office.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Since Vanuatu imposes no income, payroll, capital gains, or withholding tax, the only national statutory tax identifier available to a foreign-owned entity is the VAT Registration Number (VATRN) issued under the Value Added Tax Act No. 14 of 2011 (as amended). Procedure: (1) Incorporate the VU International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through a licensed VFSC registered agent and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, registered agent, and registered office details; (2) determine whether the IC carries on a 'taxable activity' in Vanuatu — outbound affiliate media buying for non-resident advertisers is a zero-rated export supply, so compulsory registration is triggered only when taxable supplies made in Vanuatu exceed VUV 5,000,000 in any 12-month period; (3) if registration is required or desired (for input VAT recovery), file the VCIRS VAT registration application (Form VAT-01) with a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, registered agent address, principal place of business, description of taxable supplies, and a 12-month turnover estimate; (4) on approval, the Commissioner issues a VAT Registration Certificate containing the unique VU VATRN, to be quoted on all tax invoices and customs export entries; (5) obtain an exporter code from Vanuatu Customs for ASYCUDA filings; and (6) obtain the applicable Provincial/Municipal Business Licence (e.g., Shefa Province / Port Vila Municipality) as a separate local-permit requirement. A non-registered IC has no VATRN and cannot issue tax invoices or reclaim input VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — A VU International Company is incorporated as a distinct legal person under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and operates in a zero-income-tax jurisdiction: no corporate income tax, personal income tax, capital gains tax, branch tax, or withholding tax is imposed, and the IC Act grants exemption from stamp duty and other levies on international instruments. The entity's only national tax exposures are value added tax at 12.5% on taxable supplies made in or imported into Vanuatu, customs/fiscal import duties on physical imports, the fixed VFSC annual licence fee, and provincial business licence fees. Because no income tax exists, there is no domestic reclassification of the IC as a pass-through entity, no CFC or territorial-source regime, and no restriction on foreign media-buying income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, CFC, or hybrid-mismatch election exists because Vanuatu has no income tax law and no comprehensive double-tax-treaty network. Elective mechanisms available under Vanuatu law: (a) voluntary VAT registration under the Value Added Tax Act No. 14 of 2011 — an IC making zero-rated export supplies may register to obtain a VATRN and recover input VAT on local operating costs (registered-agent fees, bank charges, hosting, professional services); (b) an election of VAT filing frequency (monthly or quarterly) based on the registered supplier's turnover bracket; (c) under the IC Act, an International Company may apply to VFSC to maintain its tax-exempt and stamp-duty-exempt status and, conversely, may elect to convert or re-domicile into a domestic company, which is generally not advisable for tax purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 14 of 2011 (as amended), effective 1 July 2011, administered by VCIRS; separate municipal/provincial business licence taxes and fiscal/customs import duties apply to goods. The system is invoice-credit based: registered suppliers charge output VAT and registered purchasers recover input VAT, with exports and specified offshore services taxed at 0%.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 42,000) of aggregate taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period for a domestic supplier carrying on a taxable activity in Vanuatu; compulsory registration applies once the threshold is met, and voluntary registration is available for zero-rated exporters. Non-resident digital-service suppliers are subject to a parallel simplified registration obligation under recent amendments when supplies to Vanuatu consumers exceed the same threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu does not operate real-time fiscal clearance, SAF-T reporting, continuous transaction controls, digital stamping, or an API-based e-invoicing platform. Registered suppliers must issue a 'tax invoice' containing the prescribed particulars (supplier name and VATRN, recipient name and address, date of supply, description, VAT-exclusive value, rate, and VAT amount or zero-rating statement); invoices may be issued on paper or as electronic documents with sequential numbering. VAT returns are filed in paper or Excel form at the VCIRS VAT Office. Physical exports are declared through the ASYCUDA customs clearance system, which is the sole electronic filing gateway relevant to export zero-rating.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the Value Added Tax Act No. 14 of 2011, a VU IC may claim the 0% export rate where: (a) supplied goods are physically removed from Vanuatu by the supplier, evidenced by an accepted customs export declaration; or (b) supplied services are rendered to a recipient who is not resident in Vanuatu and the services are not performed in connection with land situated in Vanuatu or goods situated in Vanuatu at the time of supply (including international transport and services directly facilitating exported goods). The affiliate media-buying model (digital ad arbitrage, affiliate lead generation, media placement procurement) qualifies as an export of services when the contractual counterparty is a foreign advertiser or affiliate network, the platforms and delivery channels are operated outside Vanuatu, and the commercial benefit inures outside Vanuatu. The supply must be reported on the VAT return as zero-rated rather than exempt, and input VAT on local overheads remains recoverable in the same return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Vanuatu Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA-formatted export entry) filed in the name of the VU IC, with the exporter code linked to the VATRN
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / House Waybill or Seaway Bill issued by the carrier evidencing physical removal of goods from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 or bank credit advice showing settlement of export proceeds from the foreign buyer
Commercial Invoice and Sales Contract / Purchase Order naming the foreign buyer and stated Incoterms
Packing List and weight certificate matching the export declaration

For zero-rated services: signed service agreement with the non-resident advertiser or affiliate network, platform delivery statements (e.g., ad-server or media-buying reports), and evidence of the recipient's foreign tax jurisdiction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VCIRS retains full audit and self-assessment powers over zero-rated claims and may retrospectively raise default assessments whenever the export documentation bundle is incomplete, the non-resident recipient cannot be verified, or payment has not originated from abroad. Consequences: the supply is re-characterised as standard-rated and assessed at 12.5% with penalty tax; the VAT Act prescribes graduated penalties for incorrect returns and late payment, rising to penalty tax up to 200% of the VAT shortfall for deliberate evasion, plus criminal fines (statutorily up to VUV 3,000,000) and imprisonment (up to three years) for directors or representatives who sign false zero-rating returns. Fraudulent claims also trigger clawback of input VAT credits, cancellation or suspension of the IC's VATRN, revocation of the VFSC international-company licence for compliance failures, and potential joint liability of the registered agent. Vanuatu has no exchange-control legislation and therefore no statutory repatriation deadline; nonetheless, the 180-day inward-remittance benchmark is applied by local practitioners and auditors as an export substantiation proxy, and failure to repatriate within that window may impair documentary proof of a genuine transaction.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations and maintains no exchange-control legislation. The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible on both current and capital account transactions, and there is no requirement for central bank approval for external payment transfers or profit remittance. International Companies may remit dividends and service proceeds without administrative restriction, subject only to the standard anti-money-laundering transaction monitoring of the authorized dealer bank. The VUV exchange rate operates under a managed arrangement against a basket of major trading-partner currencies, and all spot conversions must be executed through a licensed commercial bank or authorized foreign-exchange dealer under the Banking Act (Cap 62).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu imposes no statutory timeline for export-receipt repatriation and no mandatory conversion ratio into VUV. Export and service proceeds, including affiliate media-buying revenue, may be retained in USD or AUD in foreign-currency accounts and are freely remittable. The only compliance requirement is that the SWIFT payment narrative accurately reflects the underlying commercial transaction and that the beneficiary maintains supporting invoices and media-delivery records for bank transaction-monitoring purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with USD/AUD foreign-currency sub-accounts; Capital Escrow Account for inbound equity injections
Operational Account; Settlement Escrow Account for media vendor payments
Operational Account; potentially segregated Escrow Account subject to relationship approval
Operational Account (VUV-dominated with limited USD facility)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium practical viability for a Vanuatu International Company. Vanuatu has no statutory Electronic Money Institution (EMI) category; retail payment services and deposit-taking are licensable activities under the Banking Act (Cap 62) and the Financial Dealers Licensing Act, requiring an RBV license or authorized dealer status. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise and specialized multi-currency platforms generally refuse Vanuatu International Companies unless the entity maintains a local agent relationship, provides a physical business substance affirmation, and satisfies the EMI's correspondent-bank restrictions. A USD account through a licensed offshore EMI can be used only as a pass-through funding channel to the VAN-based operational bank, never as the primary treasury settlement account for regulated trade disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: RBV regulations do not impose an absolute physical-appearance mandate for corporate account opening; however, Vanuatu commercial banks and their overseas correspondent banks ordinarily require a first-time compliance interview supported by notarized passports, certified board resolutions, a certificate of good standing from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, and a letter of introduction from a licensed Vanuatu corporate service provider. Remote onboarding is achievable through video-identification, encrypted document vetting, and the use of a resident nominee-CSP representative at the bank's Port Vila branch, subject to enhanced due diligence for the affiliate media-buying industry classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume performance media arbitrage with revenue flows disproportionate to a newly incorporated IC's substance and size
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed advertiser insertion orders; media procurement agreements; read-only dashboard access to Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads proving actual ad delivery; trackable affiliate network payout reports; monthly reconciliation pack demonstrating gross ad spend versus commission margin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived offshore corporate secrecy and inability to evidence ultimate beneficial ownership due to IC nominee shareholding structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date register of directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners; UBO declaration under Vanuatu AML/CFT requirements; VFSC certificate of good standing; certified passports and utility bills of all natural-person UBOs; sworn source-of-wealth statements; bank references from the UBO's home-jurisdiction financial institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payouts to affiliate networks, ad exchanges, and monetization partners generating unusual correspondent-bank scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commission-invoice template with precise service description; master affiliate agreement executed with corporate counterparties; historical payout trail from the past operating period; client KYC files for each principal advertiser; entity-chart proof that no sanctioned or restricted jurisdiction participates in the payment chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from foreign fintech platforms (US- or Hong Kong-hosted accounts) flagged as unrelated-party funding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed capital contribution note and board resolution authorizing the share subscription; funding entity's corporate registration and UBO disclosure; correspondent-bank reference from the fintech platform; statement explaining the integration of the treasury platform into the group's global payment architecture; pre-notification of the incoming wire to the VU onboarding manager.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound funding is executed via SWIFT MT103 from the corporate treasury account (e.g., Mercury, Wise Business, or a licensed US/EU bank) to the VU commercial bank's correspondent account, using the beneficiary International Company's name and BIC. The payment narrative must state 'capital contribution / subscription of shares' with reference to the board resolution, and the beneficiary bank requires pre-clearance of the UBO certificate and source-of-funds memorandum prior to credit. For USD inbound, the wire is cleared over the New York correspondent rail and then credited either in USD or converted to VUV at the authorized dealing rate; any conversion must be captured in a treasury audit log.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for media inventory and affiliate payouts are cleared primarily by SWIFT MT103 direct beneficiary transfer in USD or AUD, with same-day or one-day settlement to the BIC of Meta, Google, TikTok, or major affiliate networks. Commercial letters of credit are not appropriate for digital media inventory; they may be used only for any goods-based affiliate or dropshipping flows, with VU commercial banks acting as confirming institution subject to trade documentation (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading). All SWIFT payments must carry a precise purpose-of-payment code and be supported by stored invoices and delivery evidence to avoid correspondent freeze risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV outright forward contracts (plain vanilla, 1-12 month tenors) permitted through authorized dealer banks for genuine economic hedging of receivables and payables
Deliverable USD/AUD forward contracts for cross-currency treasury management and interchange-rate protection between the VU operational account and USD-denominated media disbursements

Cross-currency swaps (USD/AUD) executed through licensed commercial banks under confirmed underlying exposure; VUV non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible nor available in this jurisdiction given the full convertibility of the VUV
Foreign-exchange swap contracts between USD and VUV for liquidity smoothing purposes, subject to margin and collateral terms agreed at the commercial bank's dealing room

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within one month after each anniversary of incorporation; VFSC issues renewal notice during the month preceding the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of approximately USD 50 per month or part thereof; failure to file and pay renewal fees for 90 days after demand permits the Registrar to initiate administrative strike-off following formal notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit for standard exempt International Companies; audit becomes compulsory only where the IC holds a VFSC regulatory license for a specified activity (banking, securities, insurance) or where the Registrar issues a special direction requiring an independent audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies are tax-exempt and not obliged to prepare or file financial statements under IFRS or Vanuatu Local GAAP; where financial statements are voluntarily prepared for lenders, investors, or internal management, IFRS is the generally accepted benchmark.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The IC must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at its registered office in Vanuatu. Annually, concurrent with the VFSC annual return, the registered agent must verify and confirm the current shareholder list and ultimate beneficial owners; any share transfer or UBO change must be updated in the register and notified to the VFSC within 14 days of the change.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - 3,500 per year (registered office, resident agent, and compliance administration)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (not statutorily required); USD 2,000 - 5,000 if voluntarily commissioned or ordered by the Registrar

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax at any level; an International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, exchange control and all similar state impositions under the International Companies Act [Cap.222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory tax exemption for International Companies. There is no corporate profit tax, no branch remittance tax, no payroll tax, no capital duty and no annual wealth or franchise tax. The only recurring state cost is the VFSC annual renewal fee (approximately VUV 45,000, subject to nominal capital band). Value Added Tax (12.5%) may reach the IC only if it performs prohibited domestic Vanuatu supplies exceeding the VUV 2,000,000 registration threshold; offshore performance-media buying and lead-gen arbitrage are outside the VAT net.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is prescribed in Vanuatu. The only recurring compliance filing for an International Company is the annual renewal/return submitted by the licensed VFSC registered agent through the official VFSC online registry (www.vfsc.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual - a single renewal and status filing per calendar year; no quarterly CIT declarations, estimated tax payments or audited tax schedules are required for an exempt IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The renewal application and government fee are due on or before 31 December for the following year (fiscal calendar fully decoupled from the offshore accounting year). There is no statutory tax-return deadline because no income tax accrues.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the Vanuatu resident agent, the registered office address, and the agent's certification that the entity remains an International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must hold a complete KYC file of every non-resident UBO: certified passport, proof of address, bank reference, source of funds and a business description. The registered office is a statutory address only; the IC may not trade from or manage Vanuatu-sourced operations there.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Company Name, Registration Number and Class
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered IC name, VFSC company number, and confirmation that the entity holds no onshore trading license and is not a Vanuatu local company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an ISIC 7310 media-buying vehicle, the name should reflect the offshore principal entity; ensure the entity carries no financial-services license and that all contracts name the IC as a non-Vanuatu principal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, nationality, residential address, date of birth and occupation of each director and company secretary if appointed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All directors may be non-resident. Written board resolutions must document the actual controller, the authority to sign publisher/advertiser contracts, and the treasury accounts used (Mercury, Wise, correspondent banks).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital, nominal capital band, shareholder identities and the ultimate beneficial owner declaration with ownership percentage and control chain.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the real UBO even when layered through a holding entity; provide the intermediary chain from the VU IC up to the individual. UBO changes must be delivered to the agent within 14 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sworn or certified confirmation that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu, has not held Vanuatu land, and has not created a Vanuatu permanent establishment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any domestic Vanuatu contracts, local advertising sales or onshore campaign services would void the exemption. The affiliate media-buying pipeline - demand sources, publishers, analytics and payment flows - must be entirely offshore.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the registered agent holds AML/CFT compliant beneficial-ownership data and that the IC's counterparties have been screened for sanctions exposure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening to all publishers, traffic suppliers and lead sellers; keep transaction records for at least 7 years; report unusual arbitrage margin flows (wire/ACH via Mercury or Wise) to the VFSC as suspicious transactions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No CIT late-filing penalties apply because no CIT filing exists. Defaults on the VFSC annual renewal attract late-renewal surcharges (published VFSC penalty bands, generally VUV 10,000-25,000 for the first late quarter), suspension from the registry, and ultimately strike-off and deregistration. Knowingly false statements in the renewal or BO declaration constitute offences under the VFSC Act and International Companies Act, punishable by fines and imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on any distribution by an International Company to any shareholder, resident or non-resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double-taxation agreement network in force (only TIEAs and exchange-of-information instruments). There is no domestic WHT to relieve, no treaty-relief application protocol, and no Tax Residency Certificate issuance by the VFSC for an exempt IC. Foreign shareholders relying on credit or CFC rules must obtain evidence of exemption solely through the VFSC certificate of incorporation and annual renewal receipt; they cannot obtain a Vanuatu tax-residency certificate because the IC has no taxable nexus.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% on royalties and 0% on interest. No non-resident service fee WHT, no branch profit WHT and no treaty rate differential applies. Payments for affiliate commissions, media-buying fees, software licensing and intercompany funding leave Vanuatu without tax friction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None - Vanuatu has not enacted transfer-pricing legislation; no Local File, Master File or Country-by-Country threshold in VUV exists, and the VFSC imposes no TP documentation requirement. Practical documentation obligations flow from corporate records and AML/BO retention rules only.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not apply Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations. De facto substance requirements are (i) the IC Act prohibition on domestic Vanuatu business and onholding Vanuatu land; (ii) VFSC AML/BO record substance - statutory registers, board minutes, written resolutions and source-of-funds records; and (iii) realistic organisational substance under foreign CFC, exit-tax and bank KYC rules. For an ISIC 7310 performance-media arbitrage vehicle, core commercial functions - ad inventory contracting, bid management, reconciliation and risk assumption - must be performed outside Vanuatu, with the VU IC functioning as a genuine offshore principal rather than a letterbox.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Exemption Abuse and Domestic Trading
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to carry on domestic Vanuatu business, hold Vanuatu real property, or create local revenue streams while claiming the total tax exemption; alternatively using fictitious offshore media-buying invoices to strip taxable income from a foreign operating company without any real services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of IC tax-exempt status; exposure to any applicable Vanuatu taxes, VAT at 12.5% on in-scope supplies, VFSC deregistration and strike-off; fines and restoration penalties under the International Companies Act and VFSC Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and UBOs can be personally assessed for unpaid taxes and penalties if the exemption is pierced; false statutory declarations attract criminal fines and imprisonment, while cross-border investigators may impose travel bans and asset freezes during recovery and extradition proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Artificial Substance Arbitrage
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a pure conduit for affiliate/media arbitrage margins with no real staff, office, contracts, board minutes or bank records; nominee-only directors; all decisions made by email from a foreign principal, with the Vanuatu entity simply collecting commissions and wiring out 90-99% of margins to related offshore payees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC AML/BO sanctions, agent license suspension, compulsory strike-off for non-renewal, and deregistration; foreign tax administrations may recharacterise the whole arrangement, impute the revenue to the principal, impose CFC inclusions, exit assessments, and 50-100% accuracy-related penalties on the affected group.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the group and of the VU IC face civil restitution, personal deficiency assessments, director penalty notices, travel bans and disqualification; deliberate sham arrangements can lead to fraud prosecutions and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain and update the beneficial-ownership file, refusing suspicious-transaction reports on high-volume ACH/wire flows through Mercury and Wise, or running unvetted traffic and lead sources when the entity is classified as medium-risk with enhanced due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offences under the Vanuatu Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing framework and the Money Laundering Act: substantial fines per breach, VFSC enforcement action including license revocation, freezing of bank accounts and confiscation of proceeds; foreign regulators may initiate mutual legal assistance and asset restraint.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers and the UBO can be prosecuted personally for money-laundering facilitation; penalties include imprisonment, confiscation orders, civil restitution to defrauded advertisers, and travel bans pending extradition or criminal trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Affiliate Fraud and Cross-Border Tax Evasion Red Flags
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Buying synthetic clicks, incentivized or fabricated leads, or engaged in cookie-stuffing and arbitrage misreporting to defraud advertisers; or booking 100% of group profit to the VU IC with zero demonstrable activity while the real economic functions sit in high-tax jurisdictions, without any transfer-pricing documentation, intercompany agreements or auditable campaign records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No domestic Vanuatu TP penalty exists, but the principal jurisdictions (US, Australia, Singapore, UK, EU) may apply CFC, transfer-pricing and general anti-avoidance rules with penalties of up to 100% of the underpaid tax; civil fraud actions by advertisers; VFSC deregistration; payment-rail bans by banking partners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal deficiency notices, fraudulent-trading liability, clawback of distributions, civil restitution, passport seizure and travel bans; willful evasion of foreign tax or mail/wire fraud in the affiliate scheme is indictable with long imprisonment terms and confiscation of personal assets.
